defs.def: the act of remembering who sb is when you see them, or of identifying what sth is 认出；认识；识别

ex.s: She gained recognition for her performance.
ex.t: 费用很可能比一间卧室的租金便宜得多。

ex.s: In the experiment, Goffin’s cockatoos were able to select the right tool for the job, in most cases, by visual recognition alone.
ex.t: 在实验中，Goffin的cockatoos能够选择合适的工作工具，在大多数情况下仅通过视觉识别。

ex.s: But recently it has discovered that data can be turned into new services: translation and visual recognition, to be sold to other companies.
ex.t: 但最近它发现数据可以被转化为新服务：翻译和视觉识别，然后出售给其他公司。

ex.s: Within the next 80 years, our lives may be changed beyond recognition by 3D printing.
ex.t: 在未来80年内，3D打印可能会让我们的生活发生翻天覆地的变化。

ex.s: In time, he gained recognition as one of the greatest artists China has ever known.
ex.t: 随着时间推移，他被公认为中国有史以来最伟大的艺术家之一。

defs.def: the act of accepting that sth exists, is true or is official 承认；认可

ex.s: following the latest world trend       B. getting international recognition
ex.t: 追随世界最新潮流       B. 获得国际认可

ex.s: Marty Despite its widespread recognition, my first impression was that Tuesdays with Morrie is just made up of collection of over-emotional thoughts and messages, many of which are repeated.
ex.t: Marty尽管它得到了广泛的认可，但我的第一印象是，《Tuesdays with Morrie》只是由过度情绪化的想法和信息组成，其中许多都是重复的。

ex.s: He played a key role in bringing Beijing Opera to the world, leading to the international status and recognition that it has today.
ex.t: 他在将北京歌剧院带入世界的过程中发挥了关键作用，导致其今天的国际地位和对它的承认。

defs.def: public praise and reward for sb's work or actions 赞誉；赏识；奖赏
